result.instructions: Tools for Viva.com, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show me the card payments from yesterday and which ones failed."; "What is the status of transaction 0f8c2d1e-5b7a-4c3e-9a1b-2d3e4f5a6b7c?"; "List my merchant wallets and their balances.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Viva.com data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run viva_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run viva_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run viva_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. viva_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: viva_get_transaction
tools.title: Get a transaction
tools.description: Get one card or wallet transaction by its id: amount, status (F finished, C captured, R refunded, X cancelled, E error), order code, card scheme and customer e-mail. Viva API: GET /checkout/v2/transactions/{transactionId}.

transaction_id.description: The Viva transaction id (GUID), from a payment or from viva_search_account_transactions.

tools.name: viva_search_account_transactions
tools.title: Search account transactions
tools.description: Search account (wallet) transactions between two dates, optionally for one wallet, transaction subtypes or an amount range. Dates use the Viva format, for example "2026-11-01 00:00:00 +00:00". Viva API: POST /dataservices/v2/accounttransactions/Search.

date_from.description: Start of the search, for example "2026-11-01 00:00:00 +00:00".

date_to.description: End of the search, for example "2026-11-30 23:59:59 +00:00".

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Increase it until the reply is empty.

tools.name: viva_list_merchant_wallets
tools.title: List merchant wallets
tools.description: List the merchant wallets on this account with their ids, currency and balance. Use the wallet id in viva_search_account_transactions. Viva API: GET /merchants/v1/wallets.

tools.name: viva_create_payment_order
tools.title: Create a payment order
tools.description: Create a payment order for a customer and return its orderCode. This creates a payable order; no money moves until the customer pays it on Viva's checkout. Amount is in the currency's smallest unit (1037 = 10.37 EUR), at least 30. Viva API: POST /checkout/v2/orders.

amount.description: Amount in the currency's smallest unit (cents), at least 30. 1037 means 10.37.

customer_email.description: Customer e-mail address shown on the payment form.

customer_trns.description: Short description of the purchase, shown to the customer.

merchant_trns.description: Your own reference (for example the order number), shown in the Viva app.

source_code.description: Payment source code (case-sensitive). Default is the 'Default' source.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 numeric currency code, for example 978 for EUR.

payment_timeout.description: Seconds the customer has to pay (default 1800; 65535 never expires).
